jobs.description:
Are you ready to turn strategy into action and create visible impact at the heart of a dynamic production site?

At Kruså Dairy, we are looking for a commercially minded and highly structured Business Development Manager who can connect strategy, people and execution. Working closely with the Site Director and the site leadership team, you will help shape the direction of the dairy and ensure that the right priorities and projects move forward.

If you enjoy the analytical and strategic side of consulting but want to get closer to implementation and see the results of your work, this could be the right next step for you.

How you will make an impact

As Business Development Manager, you will act as a trusted sparring partner and right hand to the Site Director. You will consolidate input from across the site, translate strategic ambitions into a clear business plan and create alignment on the initiatives that will deliver the greatest value. The environment is fast-moving, and priorities can change quickly, so your ability to bring structure, remain agile and keep stakeholders connected will be key.

Your main responsibilities will be to

• 
Drive the strategic business planning process by gathering input across the site, challenging assumptions and translating priorities into a coherent short- and long-term plan for our product growth and innovation ambitions

• 
Turn strategy into execution by identifying, structuring and driving larger cross-functional projects that improve site performance and support Kruså Dairy’s ambitions. Drive our sustainability agenda to reduce our CO2 footprint with innovation projects at our waste water plant or reducing energy consumptions of our production facility

• 
Build strong investment cases by aligning CAPEX, savings and improvement opportunities with the site leadership team, Finance and the central CAPEX stakeholders in Viby

• 
Support fact-based decision-making through clear analyses, business cases, presentations, performance insights and decision material for the Site Director and leadership team

• 
Create alignment and momentum by connecting stakeholders, communicating strategic priorities and following up on actions, milestones and value delivery across the project portfolio

The role is based at Kruså Dairy, where you will work closely with the Site Director, the site leadership team and key stakeholders across Arla, including Finance and CAPEX colleagues in Viby. While the role offers a high degree of independence, your success will depend on your ability to involve others, listen to different perspectives and create shared ownership of the site’s agenda. There is flexibility to balance time on site and working from home in line with business and team needs.

What will make you successful

We are looking for a person who brings a strategic and analytical mindset and enjoys turning complex information into clear priorities and practical actions. You are structured, curious and proactive, and you feel comfortable taking ownership while also involving others and valuing their perspectives. With a flexible and constructive approach, you navigate changing priorities and build trusting relationships through sound judgement, openness and clear communication. Besides this, we imagine that you bring

• 
A relevant master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Strategy, Economics, Engineering or a related field

• 
Experience from management consulting, business development, finance or strategy, combined with a motivation to turn problem-solving into hands-on implementation

• 
A solid understanding of how to identify and create value in a production environment

• 
Experience from manufacturing, operations, Lean or Six Sigma is an advantage, but not a requirement

• 
Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

What do we offer?

As our new Business Development Manager, you will work close to the strategic core of Kruså Dairy and influence decisions with tangible impact. The role offers broad exposure across strategy, operations, finance and continuous improvement, along with the autonomy to shape your agenda and support from the site leadership team and wider Arla network.

Would you like to join us?

If you want to combine strategy with implementation and help shape the future of Kruså Dairy, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply as soon as possible, as we will review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. The recruitment will close once the right candidate has been found. For questions, please contact Site Director, Nicoline Akkerman at +45 91315826.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Do you enjoy finding the biggest commercial opportunities, improving customer journeys, and turning data into initiatives that drive measurable growth? Keep reading!

At Limepack, E-commerce is at the heart of how we acquire and convert customers across Europe. As we grow, we see significant potential to improve the customer journey and webshop performance across our markets, while becoming much better at what happens after the first purchase: building stronger relationships, increasing repeat purchases, and growing customer lifetime value.

With our current E-commerce Manager going on maternity leave, this role has a unique starting point. You’ll initially take ownership of E-commerce growth and customer journey optimisation, but this is not simply a 10–12 month maternity cover. The role is designed to evolve with you: over time, your focus will shift towards becoming Limepack’s Loyalty Lead, taking long-term ownership of Post-Purchase, CRM & Lifecycle.

This is a role for someone who combines commercial thinking with strong execution. You’ll use data to identify where the biggest opportunities are, set priorities, and drive initiatives across teams, taking responsibility for turning ideas into measurable results.

📋 Your responsibilities and impact

Your focus will evolve as you grow into the role: starting with E-commerce and gradually taking ownership of Loyalty, CRM, Email and Lifecycle.

• Grow E-commerce performance: Own and improve webshop conversion, customer journeys, AOV and revenue across markets. Identify the biggest opportunities and turn them into scalable improvements.

• Lead and collaborate across our tech setup: For the first 10–12 months, you will lead Alexander, our UX/Frontend Developer, who will report to you, while you report to our CCO. You will also work closely with our two Backend Developers and external partners to bring initiatives from idea to implementation.

• Turn data into priorities: Use customer and commercial data to understand where we should focus, build a clear roadmap, and follow up on the KPIs that matter.

• Drive projects from idea to impact: Lead high-impact initiatives across teams, create clear ownership, and make sure the right people and resources come together to deliver on time.

• Build for scale: Look beyond one-off improvements and create solutions that can work effectively across Limepack’s European markets.

• Build our Loyalty engine: After 10-12 months, own and improve the customer journey beyond the first purchase across Post-Purchase, CRM, Email and Lifecycle. Build stronger customer relationships, increase repeat purchases and grow customer lifetime value.

What success looks like: Within your first 12 months, you’ll aim to increase webshop conversion by 30%, help deliver our 2027 E-commerce revenue target of 40M in new business, and establish clear ownership and priorities for Loyalty. Longer term, you’ll drive improvements in repeat purchase rate, CLV and lifecycle revenue, including increasing first-to-second-purchase retention from 40% to 50%.

👉 Who you are

• You think commercially: You naturally look for the opportunities that will have the biggest impact on revenue and customer value, rather than simply working through a list of tasks.

• You are analytical and curious: You enjoy digging into data, understanding what customers are doing, and using those insights to decide what to improve next.

• You make things happen: You take ownership from opportunity to execution, create structure around projects, and follow through until the result is delivered.

• You are always looking for a better way: You enjoy improving customer journeys, processes and systems and think about how solutions can be scaled rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.

• You are strong across teams: You’re comfortable driving projects through people you don’t directly manage, aligning different stakeholders, and creating clarity around priorities and ownership.

🎓 Your experience

To succeed in this role, you should bring a strong combination of E-commerce experience, commercial thinking, analytical skills and project ownership.

• You have 3–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in E-commerce, digital growth, CRO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, or a similar commercially focused role.

• You have owned E-commerce performance and can point to measurable commercial results you personally helped create.

• You have hands-on experience with CRO and customer journey optimisation and know how to turn insights into improvements.

• You are strong with data, prioritization and project management, and are comfortable coordinating initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.

• Experience with CRM, lifecycle, retention or multi-market E-commerce is a strong advantage.

🚀 Who We Are

Limepack is a profitable Copenhagen-based European scale-up making custom-branded takeaway packaging accessible to businesses of all sizes. Since 2018, we’ve expanded across 14 countries by partnering with European manufacturers to offer faster, more affordable, and more sustainable packaging solutions.

We’re growing fast: we’ve been named a Børsen Gazelle four years in a row for exceptional revenue growth (Limepack.com/growth), and our ambition is to triple revenue over the next three years.

Today, we’re a team of 33 people, including 14 remote colleagues. We put a lot of emphasis on building a great place to work, and we’re proud to be a certified Happy Workplace (Limepack.com/happy). 🚀

💚 We offer:

• A full-time position based in Copenhagen with flexibility to work from home.

• A competitive salary based on experience.

• 6 weeks of paid time off, pay during sick days, and generous paid parental leave.

• The opportunity to take ownership of an important commercial area and grow from E-commerce ownership into leading Limepack’s Loyalty, CRM & Lifecycle agenda.

Software Engineer, Technical Department, Cavendish Hydrogen, Herning

Are you ready to help advance the transition to clean mobility? At Cavendish Hydrogen, we are driven by a clear and vital mission: accelerating the global transition to zero-emission heavy-duty transportation. As a dedicated hydrogen fueling company, we design, deliver, and service cutting-edge hydrogen refueling stations (HRS) for customers across Europe, North America and Asia.

To support our growing international operations, we are looking for a curious, adaptable, and solution-oriented Software Engineer to join our Technical Department within Operations at our headquarters in Lind, Herning. In this role, you will contribute to the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of our hydrogen refueling solutions, helping customers around the world transition to sustainable transportation.

About the job

As our Software Engineer you will connect our global field operations with our in-house software and innovation teams. You will be responsible for ensuring our customers’ hydrogen fueling stations perform safely, reliably, and efficiently across the globe. You will join an agile and collaborative Technical Department comprising of seven skilled colleagues. The team supports service technicians, project managers, and international customers.

Our software architecture is fully developed in-house. You will work closely with Application Engineering and the R&D Software Team to troubleshoot operational issues, implement software adjustments, and optimize live systems.

Key responsibilities and tasks

Operational support & advanced troubleshooting

• Provide software expertise to field service technicians, project teams, and global customers.

• Analyze machine telemetry, logs, and system data to identify operational issues.

• Conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA) of software- and control-related incidents and coordinate corrective actions.

• Prioritize, manage, and escalate complex technical software challenges to relevant engineering teams.

Software adjustments & minor feature improvements

• Define, test, and deploy operational software adjustments, bug fixes, and site-specific parameter configurations.

• Implement urgent software updates while maintaining code integrity and alignment with the R&D Software Team.

• Translate field observations into clear specifications, user stories, and feature requests.

Remote commissioning support & knowledge sharing

• Support remote commissioning, factory testing, and system energization of new stations from our test facilities in Lind.

• Connect the Technical Department with Application Engineering and the R&D Software Team to support effective knowledge sharing and problem-solving.

About you

You may be a recent graduate ready to begin a career in green technology or an experienced engineer seeking meaningful industrial impact. Because our software is developed in-house, curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a willingness to learn are more important than experience with specific third-party tools.

Educational Background: You have a degree in Software Engineering, Automation & Control, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Relevant practical experience or an equivalent technical background is also welcome.

Interest in in-house software architecture: You are motivated to understand how software interacts with complex physical equipment including valves, compressors, cooling systems, and high-pressure gas controls.

PLC and automation experience: Experience with PLC programming in Structured Text under IEC 61131-3 is beneficial. Familiarity with Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 is an advantage but not a requirement.

Analytical approach: You are comfortable analyzing data and diagnostic logs and use a structured approach to root-cause investigation.

International flexibility: you can occasionally adjust your working hours to collaborate with colleagues and partners in North American or Asian time zones.

Language and communication: You communicate confidently in written and spoken English, our corporate language.

What we offer

Structured onboarding and mentoring: Experienced software and service engineers who will guide you through our software architecture and station design. Certified Beckhoff TwinCAT training may also be provided where relevant, and you will receive ongoing support from the R&D Software team.

Meaningful impact: Your work will help improve the uptime of commercial hydrogen refueling stations and keep zero-emission fleets operating.

Modern facilities in Lind: You will work in modern facilities with advanced test bays, a high-quality lunch canteen, an active staff association, and health insurance.

Flexibility & work-life balance: Your primary workplace and team will be based in Lind, with flexible working arrangements available.

No regular travel: You will support international remotely, without the need for frequent business travel.

Collaborative culture: You will join an informal and open workplace where questions, knowledge sharing, and autonomy are encouraged.

Apply now

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Curious to learn more?

For technical or role-specific questions, please contact Kim Hehlert, Technical Department Manager at +45 26 31 31 33.

For questions about the recruitment process, please contact Elsebeth Haarup Rasmussen, Head of HR, at +45 22 77 76 13.

Location: Lind, 7400 Herning, Denmark

Would you like to help ensure stable and innovative IT solutions across our European production sites?

As an IT Consultant, you’ll become part of our global IT Service & Support Team and play a key role as a liaison between users, the business, and IT. The position combines day-to-day IT support with technical consulting, implementing new solutions, and participating in projects across our European production sites.

About the position

You are a dedicated and technically skilled IT Consultant who can translate business needs into effective and well-functioning IT solutions. You will also play a key role in providing professional IT support and ensuring a high-quality user experience in both production and office environments.

Your primary focus will be our factories in Sweden (Helsingborg), Denmark, Germany, Poland, Spain, and Lithuania. Together with your colleagues, you’ll participate in a rotation program where you’ll serve as the local IT contact and technical specialist at our production sites.

You’ll have a broad network of contacts within the organization and work closely with users, from production staff to colleagues in the offices. That’s why we’re looking for someone who thrives on dialogue and collaboration, can work independently, and is able to build strong relationships across the organization.

The position is based in Gråsten and involves travel to our other European locations.

Primary tasks

You will serve as an IT technical advisor for the organization, and your primary responsibilities will include:

• Support, troubleshooting, and consulting regarding IT systems, hardware, software, and networks

• Implementation and rollout of new IT solutions, technologies, and workstations

• Supporting business-critical applications, production-related systems, and IT services

• Participating in IT projects, standardizing solutions, and documenting processes

• Collaborating with colleagues and vendors to translate business needs into stable and well-functioning IT solutions

Personal profile

We envision that you have experience in a role such as IT Support Specialist, IT Administrator, IT Consultant, or similar, where you have worked extensively with the operation, support, and implementation of IT solutions.

You have developed a broad technical understanding and thrive on translating business needs into stable, efficient, and user-friendly IT solutions.

We’d like you to have experience with:

• Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows clients, Windows Server, and Active Directory

• Networking, infrastructure, and general operations of IT environments

• IT support, troubleshooting, and user administration

• Documentation, standardization, and implementation of IT solutions

• Support for business-critical systems in production and operational environments where high availability and quality are essential

• Collaboration with users, vendors, and colleagues across the organization

We also expect you to:

• Have a relevant education, such as a degree in computer technology, IT support, or equivalent

• Communicate fluently in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing. Knowledge of German is a plus

• Be willing to travel to our European locations for an average of approximately 50% of your working hours

• Be willing to participate in a formalized 24/7 on-call schedule

• Thrive on working closely with the business and building strong relationships with users

• Work independently, take responsibility, and see your tasks through to completion

We offer

• An exciting and varied position with a high degree of independence and responsibility

• The opportunity to work across a broad range of IT support and modern cloud technologies

• A strong professional environment focused on development, collaboration, and knowledge sharing

• An attractive compensation package including a pension and health insurance, as well as a cafeteria plan and employee activities

• The job involves travel to the aforementioned locations in Europe

Process

Please upload your application and resume at https://bhj.com/career/vacant-jobs/ as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis.

Please direct any questions about the position to Allan Kjærgaard, IT Services & Support Manager, alkj@bhj.dk, tel. 7435 1218.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Medical Writer, Regulatory, Quality & Clinical Reporting, Søborg, Denmark
jobs.description:
This role is an exciting opportunity to blend scientific expertise with impactful communication, helping shape innovative healthcare solutions at a globally leading company like Novo Nordisk!

Your new the role

This is a permanent position in Medical Writing. In this role, your main responsibility will be to drive the preparation of complex clinical documents and act as a project manager. More specifically, you are expected to lead tasks such as:

• Plan, develop, and oversee high-quality regulatory and clinical documents in line with business needs and timelines.

• Prepare key documents such as study protocols, informed consent forms, investigator’s brochures, clinical summaries, and paediatric plans.

• Develop briefing packages and responses to health authority questions.

• Represent Clinical Reporting in cross-functional project teams, providing guidance on document planning, requirements, and optimal data presentation.

• Collaborate across Medical & Science, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, and Pharmacovigilance to ensure accurate, complete, and scientifically sound reporting.

We are globally oriented and you will work in close collaboration with colleagues in cross-functional teams in both Denmark and abroad. The position is office-based in Søborg, Denmark.

Your new department

You will join us in Clinical Reporting, the medical writing function at Novo, currently comprising around 200+ medical writers worldwide. We are part of Novo Development and anchored together with Regulatory and Quality functional areas. Development is responsible for managing clinical drug development and submissions to health authorities worldwide, from the early development phases to market authorisation. Our supportive culture drives business transformation, and we value continuous learning, being bold, and striving for simplicity.

Clinical Reporting covers all clinical drug development projects across therapy areas. Our main focus is to use our scientific expertise to drive clear and impactful communication on the conduct and outcome of clinical trials, and our main task is to communicate clinical data in a clear and concise manner.

Your skills and qualifications

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

• A Master’s degree within natural sciences (MSc., MSc. Pharm. or equivalent), preferably supplemented with a PhD and/or relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• A track record of driving complex tasks from start to end, navigating a multidisciplinary stakeholders’ landscape.

• A high level of expertise in communicating scientific information, with the ability to tailor such information to meet diverse objectives.

• The ability to improve processes and to promote the sharing of better practices.

• A good understanding of clinical development, regulatory processes and requirements, and clinical documents.

• Full proficiency in spoken and written English.

On a personal level, you are a clear communicator who adapts easily to a changing environment with tight deadlines. You are strategic, proactive and have excellent planning and coordination skills with the competency to drive and engage teams. You are a collaborative team player, that effectively manage various stakeholders and can reach consensus. You are detail-oriented and structured, while being pragmatic and not afraid of challenging the status quo. Furthermore, you have a positive can-do attitude and a good sense of humour.

Working at Novo NordiskEvery day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with an unconventional spirit, a rare determination, and a constant curiosity. For over 100 years, this unordinary mindset has seen us build a company unlike any other. One where a collective passion for our purpose, mutual respect, and a willingness to go beyond what we know delivers extraordinary results.

What We Offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

15th Nov 2026.

jobs.occupation: Senior Corporate Counsel - GMS CMC & Supply Chain Legal
jobs.description:
This opportunity is unordinary because it places you at the center of high-impact, international legal work within one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies, where your contributions directly shape global strategy. It uniquely combines a high-performing team environment with exposure to complex negotiations and cutting-edge legal challenges that rarely converge in a single role.

We are looking for a colleague to join the GMS CMC & Supply Chain Legal team to support our Global Manufacturing & Supply organisation. Start your application for a life-changing career!

Your new role

As legal business partner for our Global Manufacturing & Supply organisation, you will advise and support the departments responsible for the strategic sourcing and outsourcing activities related to Novo Nordisk’s production sites worldwide and the global management of suppliers. In your role, you will advise senior management and support internal stakeholders on large-scale projects, such as outsourcing and supply agreement, and act as the legal business partner on key strategic initiatives in the Global Manufacturing & Supply organisation.

You will:

• Assist and support on complex high-value and high-impact matters that attract significant senior management attention.

• Identify and assess critical legal issues, act pragmatic to find a way forward and support the business in setting out a strategy.

• Assist and support high-impact contract negotiations, including translating the impact of concessions for the business and drafting key legal terms. Collaborate with senior stakeholders to help guide their decision-making.

• Work closely with your colleagues in Global Legal, Intellectual Property and Security (GLIPS) and other colleagues across the world, leveraging all relevant competencies. ·

• Drive ad hoc projects and activities focused on optimising the way we work (e.g., improvements to our contracting setup and support model), managing assistance from external counsel, offshoring to our contracting colleagues in India, knowledge sharing, and training.

Your new department

You will be a key part of the high-performing, dynamic, and fun team consisting of 10 lawyers, 6 of which are all legal business partners to Novo Nordisk’s strategic sourcing and outsourcing department within Global Manufacturing & Supply organisation. The team is part of the Global Legal, Intellectual Property and Security (GLIPS), located in Novo Nordisk’s headquarters in Bagsværd, Denmark. Novo Nordisk’s global legal organisation consists of more than 500 legal colleagues situated in over 40 locations around the world. We want our people to have a global mindset, dedication to serving Novo Nordisk in the best possible way, and have rewarding careers. To achieve this, we invest significantly in your continued development, including through giving frequent feedback on the job, access to internal and external training opportunities, interaction with senior management, and by giving you the tools and empowerment needed to be successful.

Your skills and qualifications

• You hold a degree in Law or Business Law.

• + 6 years of post-graduation experience either from a law firm or a company with an international focus, and have a strong track record as a lawyer.

• You have strong legal acumen, including experience in drafting and negotiating international commercial contracts.

• You possess well-developed business partnering skills and an inquisitive nature, including a proactive approach to understanding our business and our stakeholders’ needs and enabling business results through best-in-class legal advice.

• You thrive as a specialist in cross-functional teams, are open be new ways of thinking and are able to adopt a broader mindset.

• You have strong written and verbal English communication skills, which enable you to clearly convey complex issues and navigate among stakeholders from different cultures and business functions.

As a person, you are personable, fosters a positive atmosphere, unites people, and builds strong connections. are resilient and have the ability to manage high-pressure stakeholder interactions.

You will join a team of highly motivated, hard-working, and collaborative professionals, who values laughter, team spirit, and a good atmosphere.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 816,800.00 to 1,200,700.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level,  location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

1 November, 2026

Enterprise IT & Quality

Ballerup, Denmark

Your impact begins here

Cyber resilience is becoming one of the most important capabilities for organisations operating in an increasingly connected world. As Programme Director, Cyber Resilience, you will lead a critical enterprise-wide programme that helps strengthen resilience across Novo Nordisk while supporting safe and efficient business operations.

Working on behalf of the Deputy CISO, you will provide leadership across a network of senior stakeholders, workstream leads and subject matter experts. This is a role where success comes through influence, governance and the ability to create alignment across organisational boundaries rather than through direct line management. You will help translate strategic ambitions into coordinated action, ensuring the programme delivers meaningful business outcomes while remaining connected to enterprise priorities.

What you'll bring

You are an experienced enterprise programme leader who thrives in complex environments and knows how to mobilise leaders around a shared vision. You bring the confidence to challenge constructively, navigate competing priorities and create momentum across large, matrixed organisations.

To succeed in this role, you will bring:

• A master's degree or equivalent professional experience within programme management, technology, cyber security, business, engineering or a related field.

• Significant experience leading complex enterprise-wide programmes, transformations, PMO initiatives or technology-focused programmes.

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of new business, partners and existing customers in one place. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished sales organisation. You build the commercial side together with the founder, and what you decide on price, pitch, process and the first hires is what Userlink will sell on for years.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The brain

The agents are the arms. The next layer is a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers: conversations on chat, email, phone and social, on-site behaviour, orders, returns and reviews.

The system identifies the moments where a sale is won or lost and intervenes while the session is still live. It scores answer coverage per product and closes the gaps, quantifies objections and unmet demand, and traces returns back to the expectation that broke.

Learning happens across all webshops, more than six million visits a month, where patterns become visible that no single shop has the traffic to see. Every intervention is measured against a control group. The patterns are shared, the data stays with each shop.

The hard problems are retrieval and evaluation of LLM output at scale, data isolation when patterns are shared across customers, latency in real-time flows, and attribution that holds up under scrutiny.

The stack

Java with Spring Boot, React and MongoDB, with language models and vector search on top. Moving the backend to C# and .NET is under consideration.

The role

Technical ownership of the platform: architecture, code quality, operations, security and prioritisation, combined with hands-on development every day. Standards for review, testing, monitoring and releases, and recruiting the next developers.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished tech organisation with fixed processes. The standards for review, testing, operations and releases, and the developers you hire, become the foundation the platform and the team grow on.
